i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load the handed-in goal and context (what you are resolving) and the starting questions, if any. Read the glossary and the topic's relevant code/docs. Record pass when loaded.
i0-context.finding: Issue 369 + code explored: 6 recent-history modules live in production fusion; quali adapters consume DriverFeatures.quali_history_full positions via _position_to_quality; race-start history is grid-to-lap gain (pace-gap inapplicable); DB lap_times has full Q coverage 2018-2025 with valid_lap/pit/track_status columns; #368 unmerged on claude/compound-regime-feasibility with pace_normalization config pattern

q1.title: Scope: which recent-history module families get pace-gap encoding?
q1.imperative: Ask: quali-only (driver+constructor) vs also race / race-start variants. Code shows race-start history is grid-to-target-lap gain (not position-quality) so 'analogously race-start' is inapplicable; race pace-gap is a separate design problem (fuel/SC). Recommend quali-only, defer race to triage.
q1.finding: Quali only: driver_quali_power_from_recent_history + constructor_quali_power_from_recent_history. Race deferred to triage follow-up; race-start dropped as inapplicable (grid-to-lap gain, not position-quality).

q2.title: Dependency: build on main independent of #368 branch?
q2.imperative: Ask: #368 (race_weekend median-relative pace) is unmerged on claude/compound-regime-feasibility. Build 369 on main with an independent config knob, or stack on/wait for #368? Recommend main + independent knob; only the formula concept is shared.
q2.finding: Build on main with an independent config knob; no code dependency on the #368 branch. Only the (t-median)/median concept is shared.

q3.title: Computation locus: where is per-event pace-gap computed?
q3.imperative: Ask: data_adapter populates a new parallel DriverFeatures field (quali_pace_gap_history_full) vs adapters querying the DB directly. Recommend data_adapter parallel field, flag-gated so default-off does zero extra DB work.
q3.finding: data_adapter populates new parallel DriverFeatures.quali_pace_gap_history_full from lap_times, only when flag on (default-off = zero extra DB work). Adapters stay pure feature consumers.

q4.title: Replace vs augment under the flag; feature schema versioning
q4.imperative: Ask: when flag on, replace position-quality channel entirely (windows/h2h/gaps over pace-gap) vs add pace-gap features alongside position features. Issue leans replace. Recommend replace under flag with feature schema v2 names; default off keeps v1 bit-identical.
q4.finding: Replace under the flag: per-event series becomes pace-gap; windows/h2h/gaps/availability run over it; feature schema v2 names (quali_pace_gap_*). Default off = v1 bit-identical. Augment A/B possible as follow-up.

q5.title: Missingness, orientation, and outlier policy for pace-gap
q5.imperative: Ask: missing (no valid green non-pit Q lap) excluded via availability machinery; gap kept lower=better mirroring position polarity; forgiveness drops highest-gap events; no clipping/winsorizing in v1 (wet sessions produce real spread). Confirm or adjust.
q5.finding: Raw gaps, no clipping in v1. Gap=(t-median)/median, t=best valid non-pit Q lap; lower=better mirrors position polarity; missing excluded via availability machinery; neutral 0.0; forgiveness drops highest gaps. Revisit clipping only if A/B shows wet poisoning.

q6.title: Evidence depth: what closes this issue?
q6.imperative: Ask: (a) unit tests + default-off bit-identical proof only; (b) plus targeted A/B training of the two quali recent-history modules (sigma/error correlation + rank_mae/sign-accuracy no-regression); (c) full gold cycle A/B. Recommend (b) per issue acceptance section.
q6.finding: Unit tests + default-off bit-identical proof, then targeted A/B: train the two quali recent-history modules flag-on, compare sigma/error correlation + rank_mae/sign-accuracy vs promoted baseline bundles. No full gold cycle.

q7.title: Adjustment: race-start disposition
q7.imperative: User correction on confirm: race-start recent-history is NOT dropped - triage it as a lower-priority investigation (what would a pace-like/variance-enriching re-encoding mean for grid-to-target-lap-gain history).
q7.finding: Race-start recent-history form encoding goes to triage as a lower-priority investigation item, alongside the race variant. Still out of scope for this run.

consolidation.summary: Issue 369 scoped to quali recent-history modules (driver+constructor) only. Flag-gated replace encoding: per-event form = (t-median)/median from best valid non-pit Q lap, computed in data_adapter as parallel DriverFeatures field when flag on; default off bit-identical. Raw gaps, missing via availability, schema v2 under flag. Evidence: unit tests + identity proof + targeted 2-module A/B. Built on main, independent of #368. Triage follow-ups: race variant (pace-gap design) AND race-start variant (lower-priority investigation of form-encoding enrichment for grid-to-lap-gain history).
